body:
In the flakes config, long-lived helpers are home-manager user services: systemd.user.services.<name> with Unit.Description, Service.ExecStart, Restart, Install.WantedBy = ["default.target"] (see parked/shpool.nix, features/attention.nix, features/satan/*). home-manager's systemd.user is Linux-only and off on the darwin host.

parked/shpool.nix is the only session-daemon precedent and it is parked because zmx replaced shpool (DEC-043). Its shape — ExecStart = "<tool> daemon"; Restart=on-failure; WantedBy=default.target — is the shape zmx refuses: there is no daemon subcommand. So zmux does not ship a service; it ships a launcher prefix that composes with whatever already exists.
title: The house systemd idiom, and the unit zmx cannot have
